rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Preamble before action — design around it.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Structural trigger is narrowed (2026-09-03) to plan mode only. The single prompt at L7 ({{prompt:agents-that-build-agents-handoff}}, expanded body: 'Write me a handoff prompt I can save and run in a fresh session later. It does three things, in order.') invokes no plan mode -- it is a one-shot generative composition ask, so no in-fence suppressor or body primer is owed. The maintainer block (L26) records this exact row as declined the same day: "the check_prompts.md §17 preamble row falls under the rule as narrowed to plan mode the same day." Residual risk is the generic, un-structural tendency of any 'write me X' ask to draw a one-line lead-in before the deliverable -- plausible but low-confidence and unobserved on this file (recorded in the regenerated sim-cache trace, curriculum/evals/sim-cache/ae101--lecture--the-handoff-prompt.behavior.json, pattern_id preamble-before-action, confidence low). Harm check: a lead-in here costs seconds of reading, doesn't obscure a bounded one-paragraph deliverable -- not the harm §17 exists to prevent (eating a high-stakes plan-mode read).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A take-home prompt asks for one bounded build.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is exactly the take-home shape the rule targets (student saves it, runs it in a fresh session later). Current fence names ONE skill and ONE starting point: 'It picks with me the one skill most worth building, and builds it' / 'starting from the shapes named here' (singular). The rule's own body records the prior violation and its fix verbatim: 'Rewritten to three moves in order: scan the work, pick the most valuable skill with me and build it, ensure efficient checks on the quality of what it produces' -- the current fence text is that exact rewrite, word for word. Maintainer L21 confirms: 'one skill, not the kit, Antti 2026-09-03: a cold session asked for N skills from two starting points does not finish inside a three-minute beat; do not re-widen.' No plural deliverable, no per-X clause, no unresolved worth-qualifier, single starting point.
